description: One vessel's calls, by IMO number, as the movement lists of the ports GADUIN reads recorded them, newest first: port, vessel name, MMSI and call sign as listed, status, expected and recorded arrival (instant_kind says whether it is the port entry or the berthing) and recorded departure in UTC, each call as the port's newest word on it that still names this IMO. Only the ports list_ports lists appear, so a voyage elsewhere is absent; no vessel positions are given. total counts every call in the window: while next_cursor is not null, call again with the same imo and days and cursor set to it.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous answer, to read the next page; give the same imo and days with it. Omit for the first page.

days.description: Look-back in days (1-365): calls with any instant in this many days before now or later. Defaults to 30.

imo.description: Seven-digit IMO ship number with a valid check digit, e.g. 9212163.

limit.description: Max calls per page (1-100). Defaults to 50.

name: get_vessel_port_calls
title: Vessel port calls
